'''Zilok'k''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] who arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to observe the ''[[Gray Secant]]'', an ancient Gree [[Starship/Legends|starship]], during the [[Galactic War]]. Along with [[Trikat'k]] and a number of Gree-equipped [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], Zilok'k served as a representative of the Gree [[Species/Legends|species]] to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Western Ice Shelf]]'s [[Imperial Firebase 3|Imperial base]].

==Behind the scenes==
Zilok'k was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree, as a Gree Reputation Vendor for Imperial players during the Relics of the Gree World Event.<ref name="TOR" />
